name: Neural Deformable Anchor (NeuDA)
definition: A neural implicit representation for high-fidelity surface reconstruction that replaces learnable feature vectors at voxel vertices with optimized 3D positions (anchors) to adaptively encode local geometry.
summary: NeuDA is a neural implicit representation for high-fidelity surface reconstruction that replaces learnable feature vectors with optimized 3D positions, called anchors, to adaptively encode local geometry.
